base_length = 80.0

outer_diameter = 55.0

step1_length = 25.0
step2_diameter = 35.0
step2_length = 25.0

mount_hole_offset = 10.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
step1_radius = step1_diameter / 2.0
step2_radius = step2_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((outer_radius, 0), (outer_radius, length))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (inner_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (inner_radius, 0))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (outer_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, step1_length/2) * Cylinder(step1_radius, step1_length)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, length - step2_length/2) * Cylinder(step2_radius, step2_length)

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)
